items.title: Polymarket August settlement rule change cut Bitcoin last-10-second trading share to 3.02 percent in five-minute contracts, COINOTAG reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket August settlement rule change cut Bitcoin last-10-second trading share to 3.02 percent in five-minute contracts, COINOTAG reports** — COINOTAG reported new research into Polymarket's five-minute Bitcoin contracts suggests an August change to settlement rules, with a time-weighted payout, has taken the heat out of trading that used to bunch in the final ten seconds, with the last-ten-second share of volume at 3.02 percent. items.title: Nevada court issues 14-day restraining order barring Kalshi from offering sports, election and entertainment contracts in the state, GambleRss reports
items.content_text: - **Nevada court issues 14-day restraining order barring Kalshi from offering sports, election and entertainment contracts in the state, GambleRss reports** — GambleRss reported Nevada's First Judicial District Court granted a 14-day temporary restraining order barring Kalshi from offering sports, election and entertainment event contracts in the state, the first time a state has forced a prediction market to halt operations. The court said the Nevada Gaming Control Board is reasonably likely to succeed on the merits, finding sports event contracts qualify as a sports pool under Nevada law and that Kalshi taking a commission makes it a percentage game. items.title: Federal judge blocks Minnesota prediction market ban, finding the law likely preempted by CFTC exclusive jurisdiction, GambleRss reports
items.content_text: - **Federal judge blocks Minnesota prediction market ban, finding the law likely preempted by CFTC exclusive jurisdiction, GambleRss reports** — GambleRss reported Judge Katherine Menendez issued a 44-page ruling granting preliminary injunctive relief to the CFTC, Kalshi and Polymarket US, concluding Minnesota's prediction market statute is likely at least partially preempted because the CFTC has exclusive jurisdiction over swaps traded on designated contract markets. The ruling found the platforms faced irreparable harm from possible criminal prosecution and substantial liability if trades had to be cancelled. items.content_text: - **BitGo and Kalshi Prime launch crypto-backed margin financing for institutional traders, The FX Times reports** — BitGo and Kalshi Prime announced on Oct. 22 a crypto-backed margin financing network called HODL Margining, allowing eligible traders to use Bitcoin, Ethereum or eligible stablecoins held with qualified custodians as collateral for US dollar loans from Kalshi Katalyst to finance margin on KalshiEX. items.title: Israel election turnout reaches 74.3 percent by 8 PM as exit polls show Eisenkot bloc at 52 to 53 seats against Netanyahu bloc at 50, Market Flux reports
items.content_text: - **Israel election turnout reaches 74.3 percent by 8 PM as exit polls show Eisenkot bloc at 52 to 53 seats against Netanyahu bloc at 50, Market Flux reports** — Market Flux reported voter turnout reached 74.3 percent of eligible voters by 8 PM local time, the highest recorded at that hour since 1988, and that Israel's election commission rejected Netanyahu's request to extend voting hours.
